mapper.select: SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_date_time, f.arrival_date_time, f.base_fare, f.status, f.booked_a_seats, f.booked_b_seats, f.booked_c_seats, src.airport_code as source_code, src.airport_name as source_name, src.city as source_city, dest.airport_code as dest_code, dest.airport_name as dest_name, dest.city as dest_city, ac.aircraft_id, ac.model as aircraft_model, ac.capacity as aircraft_capacity FROM flights f JOIN airports src ON f.source_airport_code = src.airport_code JOIN airports dest ON f.destination_airport_code = dest.airport_code JOIN aircrafts ac ON f.aircraft_id = ac.aircraft_id WHERE f.flight_id = #{flightId}

SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_date_time, f.arrival_date_time, f.base_fare, f.status, f.booked_a_seats, f.booked_b_seats, f.booked_c_seats, src.airport_code as source_code, src.airport_name as source_name, src.city as source_city, dest.airport_code as dest_code, dest.airport_name as dest_name, dest.city as dest_city, ac.aircraft_id, ac.model as aircraft_model, ac.capacity as aircraft_capacity FROM flights f JOIN airports src ON f.source_airport_code = src.airport_code JOIN airports dest ON f.destination_airport_code = dest.airport_code JOIN aircrafts ac ON f.aircraft_id = ac.aircraft_id
mapper.update: UPDATE flights SET source_airport_code = #{source.airportCode}, destination_airport_code = #{destination.airportCode}, departure_date_time = #{departureDateTime}, arrival_date_time = #{arrivalDateTime}, aircraft_id = #{aircraft.aircraftId}, base_fare = #{baseFare}, status = #{status}, booked_a_seats = #{bookedASeats}, booked_b_seats = #{bookedBSeats}, booked_c_seats = #{bookedCSeats} WHERE flight_id = #{flightId}
